title: Pursuit Sport Fishing Charters

services.name: 5 Hour Charter
services.desc: 5 + 6 hour charters are perfect when the salmon are close to home like January, February, March, August and September or for those that have limited time or budget. During August and September this can be just enough time to go find the big fish and have some fun. 8 hour charters are our most popular charters. We recommend this charter so we can take advantage of at least 1 full tide change and go a little further to find better fishing if needed. 10 hour charters are required for our Gulf Islands charters.
